Dirattatirattaṁ.g: 1 ettha yathā antarantarā sahaseyyāvasena tirattaṁ aggahetvā nirantarameva tisso rattiyo anupasampannena saddhiṁ sahaseyyāya aruṇuṭṭhāpanavasena tirattaggahaṇatthaṁ “dirattatirattan”ti abyavadhānena vuttanti dirattaggahaṇassa payojanampi sakkā gahetuṁ, evamidhāpi
ettha dirattaggahaṇaṁ vacanālaṅkāratthaṁ, nirantaraṁ tissova rattiyo vasitvā catutthadivasādīsu sayantasseva āpatti, na ekantarikādivasena sayantassāti dassanatthampīti daṭṭhabbaṁ.
ettha dirattavacanena na koci visesattho labbhati, kevalaṁ lokavohāravasena byañjanasiliṭṭhatāya, mukhāruḷhatāya evaṁ vuttanti veditabbaṁ.

dirattaṁ.l: Ekarattaṁ dirattaṁ vā, dukkhaṁ vasati verisū
dirattaṁ.g: , verīnañhi antare vasanto ekāhampi dvīhampi dukkhameva vasatīti attho.
